title: Chapter 1499 - 615: Golden Blood Pill Pearl (Part 2)
content:
Chapter 1499: Chapter 615: Golden Blood Pill Pearl (Part 2)

The elixir pearls dispersed, becoming a healing medicine capable of mending bodily cracks, reconnecting severed meridians, replenishing depleted mana, and nurturing divine sense mixed within the golden blood.

Every elixir pearl condensed acts as the core of life extension, able to replace the heart in pulsating golden blood, and post limb loss, draw the body back to unity. Even if bodily parts are separated too far, the elixir pearls can transform into bones and blood, into skin and flesh!

The golden light within the formation grew increasingly vibrant.

The Flowing Gold Guest, enduring intense pain, finally fully condensed the first Golden Blood Pill Pearl at his chest!

It was only fingertip-sized, yet dazzling red gold, with faint pill patterns circulating on the surface, resembling a small golden sun submerged in the depths of flesh.

Immediately after, a second point of golden light shone from his abdomen.

The second Golden Blood Pill Pearl condensed even slower but steadier, like a golden star rising from the deep core of the earth.

The third one formed below his throat.

It was the smallest yet the sharpest, flickering like a golden knife held within the blood.

Three Golden Blood Pill Pearls interlinked, forming a cycle of golden blood.

The screams of the Flowing Gold Guest gradually diminished, replaced by heavy panting.

Blood patterns split open on the surface of his skin, not fresh blood but radiant red gold light.

Light flowed like pill liquid returning to the furnace.

The losses, hidden injuries, and shadows of fear left by two battles against Ning Zhuo were forcibly flushed away at this moment.

His aura began to surge massively!

Though not truly breaking through the realm to Nascent Soul, his aura was visibly elevated forcibly to a higher level.

"Ahhh..." The Flowing Gold Guest roared towards the sky, waves of air burst forth from his body in all directions.

For a moment, the walls of the Cloud Cave trembled, Thunder Nails resonated, golden sand surged!

Various cultivators observed the Flowing Gold Guest within the formation, their expressions varied.

Lei Wangyue’s eyes held a look of satisfaction.

The Golden Hairpin Old Woman felt a pang of heartache.

Wen Suzhen frowned, evidently calculating how long this body could endure.

Jin Mantang murmured quietly, "This time, it really cost a fortune."

Ye Qingming gazed at the Flowing Gold Guest, speaking softly, "I hope he doesn’t lose again."

Though said lightly, it weighed heavily on everyone’s heart simultaneously.

"Ning Zhuo..." In the minds of the cultivators present, the image of the big-headed youth surfaced.

Even though he was merely at Foundation Establishment Mid-Stage, the Golden Core Cultivators all felt a heavy sense of oppression.

The formation light gradually faded.

Out of twelve Life Candles, three were completely burned out, and the remaining nine lowered considerably.

The Flowing Gold Guest knelt on the golden platform, head lowered, motionless for a while.

He was drenched in sweat, covered in fresh blood.

After extreme exhaustion, a brand-new power surged from the depths of his body, promptly resonating throughout.

He slightly raised his head, the corners of his mouth moved, and he smiled.

First was a low chuckle.

Then a hearty laugh.

The laughter echoed in the Cloud Cave, causing the golden sand to quiver and leap.

He fully raised his head, his eyes were no longer just golden light, but each held a rotating pill shadow deep within.

His chest, abdomen, and throat—three largest Golden Blood Pill Pearls brightened simultaneously, their light penetrating the flesh, like three small suns hidden within him.

He extended his right hand.

His palm split open, golden blood surged out, forming a small elixir pill.

The elixir pill dispersed, transforming into golden mist, nurturing the palm.

That hand previously scorched and cracked by Thunder Marrow now rapidly restored at a visible rate, skin and flesh rejuvenating, golden light subdued.

The Flowing Gold Guest watched this scene, breathing increasingly heavily.

Powerful.

Unprecedentedly powerful!

He felt his golden blood no longer merely as blood but like rivers of golden flow. The three largest Golden Blood Pill Pearls were like three water gates that could store, release, disperse, condense.

As long as the elixir pearls remained intact, he could continuously recover.

As long as golden blood never exhausted, he could continuously fight.

"This is only the beginning; I can condense more Golden Blood Pill Pearls and store them within my body!"

What else can Ning Zhuo do?

Behead me?

Below his throat now lies a Golden Blood Pill Pearl, and at the instant of decapitation, the pill pearl can disperse into a nourishing golden mist, stabilizing both ends of head and body.

Consume mana?

His chest and abdomen’s two main pill pearls rotate, sustaining endurance far superior to the Nine Orifice Blood Gold Embryo.

Mechanical Bird Group?

Although the Golden Stone Opening Skill was taken by Ning Zhuo, the quasi-divine power has formed, and its might will surges rapidly, the upper limit so high that even the Flowing Gold Guest cannot anticipate it.

The Flowing Gold Guest stood up.

His physical body was unprecedentedly formidable, yet the fear within his heart had not completely dissipated.

Ning Zhuo’s two strikes had deeply engraved into his mind.

However, at this moment, the fear was suppressed by a more overwhelming feeling of power. Like a shadow sinking at the bottom of the water, only able to shrink into the corners under the blaze of a red gold great sun.

"Ning Zhuo..." The Flowing Gold Guest murmured this name softly.

This time, his voice finally contained more than just tremors.

There was greed, venom, and a rekindled fighting spirit!

He raised his head to look at the crowd, grinning, as if golden light flowed between his teeth.

"The third battle, I will win!"

Lei Wangyue laughed heartily: "Good!"

The Golden Hairpin Old Woman leaned on her staff to stand: "Remember, you are not alone. You are with us. You need to force Ning Zhuo to flee miserably, showing everyone that Flowing Cloud Peak cannot be trampled by Nanming Village."

Wen Suzhen reminded: "Though three Golden Blood Pill Pearls are formed, they are still just a quasi-divine power prototype. Do not underestimate the enemy."

The Flowing Gold Guest snorted coldly.

He clenched his fists.

Golden blood surged within his fist, as if a power like mountains calling and seas roaring emanated.

Quasi-Divine Power, Golden Liquid Returning Pill!

He could not think of what possibility there was for defeat, considering such strength.

Thousand Furnace Peak.

Underground black market.

The gray-robed cultivator saw the person coming, and lightly paused his fingers: "You’re here."

In these recent days, Sun Lingtong hadn’t attempted any Xingyun Trial, coming here multiple times to discuss Demon Soul procurement with the gray-robed cultivator, becoming more familiar with each other than before.

After a few conversations, Sun Lingtong once again showed great generosity, purchasing a quantity of Demon Souls that alarmed and worried the gray-robed cultivator.

"Are you buying souls or raiding the Tribulation Prison?" sighed the gray-robed cultivator.

Sun Lingtong snorted coldly: "This trade is clear as day, what talk of raiding the Tribulation Prison? You are overthinking it."

The gray-robed cultivator shook his head: "Nascent Soul Level Demon Souls aren’t wild Yin Souls. Each one here has a notable background, even if their Soul Body is worn down, they are names known to all. You’re buying this many at once, are you planning on cultivating some Great Demon Technique or saving someone?"

"You’ve come more than enough, but I can only sell you one Nascent Soul Level Demon Soul."

Sun Lingtong: "Hm?"

The gray-robed cultivator: "But the Golden Core Level Demon Souls can be unlimited in quantity."

Sun Lingtong snorted: "Even your Golden Core Level Demon Souls are not numerous."

The gray-robed cultivator handed over a Jade Slip: "Please, understand, I’m just here for business. If something goes wrong, it’s as good as asking for death for me."

"If multiple Nascent Soul Level Demon Cultivators simultaneously appear in one person’s hand, just this news alone will have the Evil Slaying Hall immediately investigating me."

Sun Lingtong was unwilling to give up: "The price can be increased."

The gray-robed cultivator shook his head repeatedly: "No matter how much you add, it’s impossible."

Sun Lingtong sighed: "Black market trade, isn’t it all about those daring making the kill? With such a small courage, when will you ever make it big?"

The gray-robed cultivator deeply sighed, displaying unprecedented determination: "Those daring have long been locked in the Cloud Prison."

Sun Lingtong was about to speak when yet another cultivator approached.

Cloaked in black, the figure was not tall, wearing a half silver mask that exposed the lips—extremely thin, as if cut from paper by a knife.

"Is the Seven Evils Blade Demon still here?"

The gray-robed cultivator frowned: "Mr. Ying Zhang, you’re slightly late. Whether this Nascent Soul Demon Soul is present depends on this gentleman."

The silver-masked and black-cloaked cultivator looked at Sun Lingtong and smiled slightly: "Did fellow Daoist take a fancy to the Seven Evils Blade Demon?"

Sun Lingtong’s mind stirred: "Mr. Ying Zhang. It’s him..."

This person, Sun Lingtong knew a bit about, was a merchant specializing in selling intelligence within the black market.

Commerce Hall sold vast information publicly accessible, but those like the Myriad Images Sect’s inside news, power struggles, past secrets, were absolutely not available there. But through Mr. Ying Zhang, it could be possible.

Sun Lingtong thought of something and chuckled lightly: "Took a fancy to some, if you particularly want it, giving it to you is not impossible."

Mr. Ying Zhang immediately understood: "What do you want?"
